name: Vedabase (Bhaktivedanta Book Trust)
note: Prabhupada translations and purports are (c) BBT and actively enforced. Named repeatedly in reference/FEATURE-REFERENCE-PLAN.md - it must NOT be used. No extraction, no quoting, no paraphrase-from.

name: Personal blogs (generic)
note: Reference doc section 2 rule: no random blogs, unverified social posts, or AI-only content as base truth for sacred content.

name: Q&A sites (generic)
note: Same rule as above. Acceptable as a lead to a primary text; never as a citation.
